apiContracts: Both write routes require positive safe-integer novel_id and chapter_number.
The exact chapter must belong to the requested published novel, have publication_status='published', and the novel must be rights-eligible.
The owner is always authenticated session u.id; request payload cannot select another user.
dataEntities: Existing bookmarks and history tables only; no schema changes.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuses existing bookmarks/history, novels and chapters entities.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Valid existing published chapter targets continue to work; malformed or invalid targets now return 400 or 404 rather than being persisted.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the route validation and tests if a regression is verified; no data migration or production D1 change is required.

privacySecurity.authentication: Both POST handlers require the existing authenticated session.
privacySecurity.authorization: Writes bind owner exclusively to u.id.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: No request-supplied user identifier is accepted; each row is stored under the authenticated session owner.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Existing request body handling remains unchanged; identifiers are strictly validated.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Only published chapters under published rights-eligible novels can be stored as progress targets.

integration: Canonical migration replay in isolated SQLite
isolation: Authenticated owner scoping remains u.id-only; local D1 cross-account integration remains a release criterion.

stagingSteps: Run all six integration workflows on exact PR head.
Verify invalid target requests return 400/404 without writes.
Verify two-account isolation in the local D1 Worker harness.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert this bounded route/policy slice if regressions are detected.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No schema or production data mutation.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No new routes; existing POST /api/bookmark and POST /api/history behavior hardened.
collisionReview.migrationAllocation: No migration allocated; historical migrations remain immutable.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Worker route implementation by platform-kernel; policy by reader; inventories by platform-architecture; tests by platform-quality; CI by delivery-platform.

changeSummary: Validates bookmark and history write targets against exact published chapter and rights-eligible novel relationships before persisting session-owned progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Positive safe-integer novel and chapter identifiers are required.
The exact requested chapter must belong to the requested novel and be published.
The novel must be published and rights-eligible.
Rejected targets do not mutate bookmark or history rows.
Writes bind user_id only to authenticated session u.id.
No migration or new route is introduced.
